spec_features.spec_quote: Better: Fixed max_turns per task (configurable, default=20)
spec_features.evidence: Enforced end-to-end: eval_runner.py:74 `while turn < max_turns and not tool_loop.is_complete():` ends the loop; tool_loop.py:176 `is_complete()` returns `self.turn_count >= self.max_turns`; turn_count increments per tool call (tool_loop.py:84). Default max_turns=20 at eval_runner.py:44 / tool_loop.py:68. Loop terminates and tool_loop.py:181 sets final_state='abandoned'. NOTE: the EvalConfig.max_turns_per_task field (config.py:69) is NOT wired into run_task/run_full_eval (run_full_eval at eval_runner.py:138 never accepts or passes it), so the config knob is unused; but the hard-coded default of 20 IS actually enforced as a turn cap that stops execution.
spec_features.notes: The two spec quotes refer to the same single mechanism. The cap is genuinely checked and breaks the loop. The config-preset field max_turns_per_task is unused/never threaded through, but the enforced default param makes the cap real.
